# Raas~Rang Garba Nights 2026

> Purvanchal's Premier Navratri Cultural Showcase & Festive Brand Expo.

## Overview
- **Event Name:** Raas~Rang Garba Nights 2026
- **Date:** 17 October 2026
- **Time:** 06:00 PM onwards
- **Venue:** Mahant Digvijaynath Park, Ramgarh Tal Road, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh 273001, India
- **Coordinates:** 26.7606° N, 83.3732° E
- **Celebrity Guest & Artist:** DJ Daizy & Special Performers
- **Official Website:** https://raasranggkp.pages.dev/
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/raasrang_gkp

## Ticket Passes
1. **Sigma Pass (Single Person Entry):** ₹499
   - Access to main Garba arena, food court, and brand stalls.
2. **Couple Pass (2 Persons Entry):** ₹899
   - Couple entry, complimentary dandiya sticks pair, access to all zones.
3. **Family Pass (4 Persons Entry):** ₹1,699
   - Entry for 4 persons, priority fast-track entry, complimentary dandiya sticks, dedicated lounge access.

## Event Highlights
- Traditional Garba & Dandiya Raas with live dhol and orchestra
- Electrifying festive DJ set by DJ Daizy
- Traditional dress competitions & awards
- Curated food street with regional delicacies
- Professional photo booths and festive ambiance

## Booking & Inquiries
- Tickets can be booked online via the official portal or BookMyShow.
- Physical passes are available at authorized spots in Gorakhpur (e.g., Caha Gorakhpur, Taramandal).
